description: This source file defines the NotesRepositorySqlite class, which serves as a repository for managing Note objects backed by an SQLite database. It provides methods to query, update, delete, and observe notes using coroutines and Kotlin Flow for reactive data handling.

classes.name: NotesRepositorySqlite
classes.description: Repository class managing notes stored in an SQLite database, providing search, CRUD, and observation functionalities.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and refreshes the note list based on the query.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Returns the StateFlow of the current list of notes for reactive observation.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note in the database and refreshes the list.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID and refreshes the list.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Private method to refresh the list of notes from the database based on the current query.
